name: Kuehne + Nagel India
india_angle: Kuehne + Nagel India provides specialized logistics solutions for the semiconductor industry, focusing on supply chain support and time-critical delivery.
summary: Kuehne + Nagel India offers specialized logistics solutions tailored to the semiconductor industry's complex supply chain needs. They provide end-to-end support from raw materials to capital equipment, ensuring time-critical delivery and digital visibility. Their global network and certified logistics stations enhance supply chain resilience for semiconductor companies.
